args.body: Take GUMROAD-FIRST-BUYER-ACCESS as a bounded acquisition decision. The settlement report establishes documented payout mechanics, not accessible discovery. Check whether prior-sales requirements make Discover unsuitable for acquiring our first buyer. No speculative package preparation or another platform comparison. Preserve existing experiment windows and private boundaries; unknown feedback is not zero demand.

description: Feedback is available but contains no classified commercial events and three unclassified sources; demand remains unknown. Gumroad's settlement report leaves its discovery prerequisites unverified, so its marketplace cannot yet be treated as an acquisition channel. Test that specific dependency without building inventory or waiting for funding. Existing live experiments remain unchanged; no revenue is verified.
